meta.summary: Two angle bisectors meet at the incentre $I$; its foot on $AB$ gives the inscribed circle.

mkp-math:construction@1.name: construction
mkp-math:construction@1.about: A ruler-and-compass construction over points A, B and C that you drag; every step follows.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.about: the steps, in order; args name points or earlier steps

inputs.name: a
inputs.about: where A starts

inputs.name: b
inputs.about: where B starts

inputs.name: c
inputs.about: where C starts

inputs.name: free
inputs.about: how many free points: A and B, or A, B and C

inputs.name: r
inputs.about: the view is −r..r up and down, and as wide again as the frame needs

inputs.name: caption
inputs.about: what the construction shows, in the bar

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the frame's title

values.name: asp
comment: the view: −r..r up and down, widened for the frame

value.expr: if(free == 3, put(put(put({}, "A", gpt(A)), "B", gpt(B)), "C", gpt(C)), put(put({}, "A", gpt(A)), "B", gpt(B)))

values.name: gstep
values.body: if(op == segment, {kind: seg, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: 0}, if(op == line, {kind: ln, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: 0}, if(op == circle, {kind: circ, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: gdist(o[0].a, o[1].a)}, if(op == midpoint, gpt(gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5)), if(op == bisector, {kind: ln, a: gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5), b: gadd(gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5), gturn(gsub(o[1].a, o[0].a))), r: 0}, if(op == perpendicular, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gturn(gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a))), r: 0}, if(op == parallel, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a)), r: 0}, if(op == angle, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gadd(gunit(gsub(o[0].a, o[1].a)), gunit(gsub(o[2].a, o[1].a)))), r: 0}, if(op == meet, gpt(gmeet(o[0].a, o[0].b, o[1].a, o[1].b)), gpt(gmeet(o[0].a, o[0].b, o[1].a, gadd(o[1].a, gturn(gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a))))))))))))))
comment: one construction step from the objects so far

value.expr: fold(range(0, len(steps) - 1), start, (d, k) => put(d, nm(k), gstep(steps[k].op, map(steps[k].args, n => get(d, n, gpt((0, 0)))))))
if(caption != "", caption, if(free == 3, "Drag $A$, $B$ or $C$: every step follows.", "Drag $A$ or $B$: every step follows."))

label.expr: if(caption == "", "A construction over points you can drag", caption)

a.v: A construction over points you can drag

comment: the free points, with a ring each

local:mkp-math:construction@1:gstep#0<ch.name: gstep
local:mkp-math:construction@1:gstep#0<ch.src: if(op == segment, {kind: seg, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: 0}, if(op == line, {kind: ln, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: 0}, if(op == circle, {kind: circ, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: gdist(o[0].a, o[1].a)}, if(op == midpoint, gpt(gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5)), if(op == bisector, {kind: ln, a: gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5), b: gadd(gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5), gturn(gsub(o[1].a, o[0].a))), r: 0}, if(op == perpendicular, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gturn(gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a))), r: 0}, if(op == parallel, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a)), r: 0}, if(op == angle, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gadd(gunit(gsub(o[0].a, o[1].a)), gunit(gsub(o[2].a, o[1].a)))), r: 0}, if(op == meet, gpt(gmeet(o[0].a, o[0].b, o[1].a, o[1].b)), gpt(gmeet(o[0].a, o[0].b, o[1].a, gadd(o[1].a, gturn(gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a))))))))))))))

core:text@1.name: text
core:text@1.about: A styled run of inline Markdown with inline maths.

inputs.name: lines
inputs.about: height kept for this many lines, so a shorter text moves nothing below it

inputs.name: literal
inputs.about: show the value as it is, not read as inline Markdown

inputs.name: caps
inputs.about: in spaced capitals: a caption or a label over a column

inputs.name: pad
inputs.about: inner padding

inputs.name: gap
inputs.about: space between children

inputs.name: align
inputs.about: cross-axis alignment

inputs.name: fill
inputs.about: background

inputs.name: tint
inputs.about: a wash of this colour behind it: a state, not a surface

inputs.name: stroke
inputs.about: border

inputs.name: line
inputs.about: the border's line

inputs.name: radius
inputs.about: corner radius

inputs.name: dim
inputs.about: faded back, while something else is in focus

inputs.name: blur
inputs.about: blurred past reading, until it is revealed

core:canvas@1.name: canvas
core:canvas@1.about: A 2D coordinate space with layers drawn in the order written.

inputs.name: z
inputs.about: 3D only

inputs.name: aspect
inputs.about: width over height; 0 means from the ranges

inputs.name: dims
inputs.about: 3 needs gfx@1

inputs.name: view
inputs.about: 3D camera: azimuth and elevation in degrees

core:zoom@1.name: zoom
core:zoom@1.about: A view the reader can zoom and pan once they unlock it, so scrolling the page past it is never caught by it. It starts locked; a try to zoom or pan then points at the lock.

inputs.name: max
inputs.about: how far it zooms in

inputs.name: fit
inputs.about: at rest, what is wider than the view is shrunk to fit it (never enlarged)

core:frame@1.name: frame
core:frame@1.about: A widget's shell: what kind of thing it is and its title above a stage, and a bar of controls along the bottom. Nothing the reader does changes its size: what doesn't fit goes in its drawers or full screen.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of thing it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: the stage's height at rest (the reader can drag it); none: as tall as its content

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: one line in the bar: what is happening now

inputs.name: statuslines
inputs.about: how many lines the status keeps room for (1 to 3): a verdict with its reason

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: tints the bar: how an answer went (ok, bad) or a note (info)

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: right of the title: the widget's own switches

inputs.name: bar
inputs.about: the bar: what is placed here, after the widget's own controls

inputs.name: about
inputs.about: a drawer: assumptions, and how to read it

inputs.name: details
inputs.about: a drawer: everything at once, such as the full table

mkp-math:gpt#0.name: gpt
mkp-math:gpt#0.src: {kind: pt, a: p, b: p, r: 0}

mkp-math:gend#0.name: gend
mkp-math:gend#0.src: gadd(o.a, gscale(gsub(o.b, o.a), if(gt0(o, rx, ry) > gt1(o, rx, ry), 0, if(s < 0, gt0(o, rx, ry), gt1(o, rx, ry)))))

mkp-math:gt0#0.name: gt0
mkp-math:gt0#0.src: max(glo(o.a.x, o.b.x - o.a.x, rx), glo(o.a.y, o.b.y - o.a.y, ry))

mkp-math:gt1#0.name: gt1
mkp-math:gt1#0.src: min(ghi(o.a.x, o.b.x - o.a.x, rx), ghi(o.a.y, o.b.y - o.a.y, ry))

mkp-math:gmeet#0.name: gmeet
mkp-math:gmeet#0.src: gadd(a1, gscale(gsub(b1, a1), gcross(gsub(a2, a1), gsub(b2, a2))/gnz(gcross(gsub(b1, a1), gsub(b2, a2)))))
